name: retail-decision-desktop
description: App de escritorio (Analista comercial, Responsable de precios y Planeador, D-31) — Electron + React + TypeScript, XML exclusivo.
author: Fernando Olivares del Valle

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode production && electron-builder
scripts.build:unpacked: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode production && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:staging: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode staging && electron-builder --dir
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
